description: Payout of a parlay (accumulator) of 2 to 20 legs that all win: combined decimal odds = product of leg decimals; payout = stake * combined; profit = payout - stake; combined implied probability = 1 / combined (legs assumed independent). For adults 21+ only. Entertainment and analysis; no wins are promised and past results do not predict future ones. BetsBeats does not take bets.
name: parlay_payout
title: Parlay Payout
